page.title: Photos | Trent Conley
page.heading: Photos
page.author: Trent Conley
page.description: Landscapes, passing moments, and skies after dark.

photos.title: Last light on the mountains
photos.alt: Pink and gold clouds above a snow-capped mountain range and a green valley.

photos.title: Under the Milky Way
photos.alt: The bright core of the Milky Way above a dark mountain ridge, surrounded by a dense field of stars.

photos.title: A curious neighbor
photos.alt: A close portrait of a horned sheep in warm light with trees softly blurred behind it.

photos.title: Light across the fjord
photos.alt: Wooden cabins above a still fjord, with sunlight crossing the green mountains beyond.

photos.title: Coastal layers
photos.alt: Dark coastal ridges rise through low mist beneath a luminous golden sky.

photos.title: Low flight
photos.alt: A seabird glides low over softly lit waves and the shoreline.

photos.title: Water and stone
photos.alt: Waterfalls plunge into a deep green gorge, where a white river winds between cliffs.

photos.title: Through the arch
photos.alt: A stone archway frames a quiet waterfront, cobblestones, and golden evening light.

photos.title: One last walk
photos.alt: A lone silhouette walks by blue surf beneath a pink sky and distant mountains.

photos.title: After hours
photos.alt: Red and white light trails thread through a narrow street lined with golden buildings.

photos.title: Beneath the branches
photos.alt: Overhanging branches frame a wooden cabin with mountains rising beyond.

photos.title: The city at dusk
photos.alt: Ornate rooftops and a central dome beneath a pink and blue evening sky.

photos.title: Open water
photos.alt: A small sailing ship on a vast blue sea beneath layered clouds.

photos.title: Watchful
photos.alt: A small tabby cat peeks over a stone ledge beside a fence and green foliage.

photos.title: Sunbreak
photos.alt: A shaft of sunlight falls on a lakeside town and the mountain slopes behind it.

photos.title: Golden hour
photos.alt: Golden sunlight breaks through layered clouds and falls across the ocean.

photos.title: Day into night
photos.alt: Brilliant red sunset clouds stretch above dark ocean water and a distant headland.

photos.title: Along the shore
photos.alt: A walker and a low-flying bird move along the beach beside softly glowing waves.

photos.title: Alpine spring
photos.alt: Pale purple flowers in a mountain meadow beneath rocky peaks and drifting clouds.

photos.title: A quiet canal
photos.alt: A narrow canal runs between pastel buildings beside a cobblestone path.
